single.layoutScript:
# One fence: cycles against the threads per block, one panel per cluster size.
import matplotlib as mpl
HOUSE = {
    "font.size": 16, "axes.titlesize": 17, "axes.labelsize": 16,
    "xtick.labelsize": 13, "ytick.labelsize": 13, "figure.titlesize": 18,
    "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.spines.top": False,
    "lines.linewidth": 2.2, "lines.markersize": 7,
}
TITLE = "cluster.sync(): mean of 1000 iterations after warmup"
COLOR = "#1f77b4"


def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    mpl.rcdefaults()
    mpl.rcParams.update(HOUSE)
    fig.clear()
    fig.set_layout_engine("constrained")
    fig.set_size_inches(13, 6)
    axes = fig.subplots(1, 2, sharey=True)
    sizes = sorted(df["block_size"].unique())
    x = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(sizes)}   # equal steps: the sizes double
    for axis, cluster_size in zip(axes, (1, 12)):
        d = df[df["cluster_size"] == cluster_size].sort_values("block_size")
        where = [x[s] for s in d["block_size"]]
        # The line is the median over the blocks; the bars are their min and max:
        # in a cluster the blocks sit on different TPCs.
        axis.errorbar(where, d["median_cycles"],
                      yerr=[d["median_cycles"] - d["min_cycles"], d["max_cycles"] - d["median_cycles"]],
                      color=COLOR, marker="o", capsize=4)
        for i, top, value in zip(where, d["max_cycles"], d["median_cycles"]):
            axis.annotate(f"{value:.0f}", (i, top), xytext=(0, 7), textcoords="offset points",
                          ha="center", fontsize=12, color="0.25")
        axis.set_xticks(range(len(sizes)))
        axis.set_xticklabels([str(int(s)) for s in sizes])
        axis.set_xlabel("threads per block")
        axis.set_title("1 block" if cluster_size == 1 else f"cluster of {cluster_size} blocks")
        axis.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=0.3)
    axes[0].set_ylabel("cycles")
    axes[0].set_ylim(0, df["max_cycles"].max() * 1.15)   # room for the labels
    fig.suptitle(TITLE)
